NK cells.description: Natural killer cells with cytotoxic granules and expression of NKG7 and GNLY, mediating innate immune responses.

Intermediate CD14+CD16+ monocyte.description: Intermediate monocytes co-express CD14 and CD16, exhibit both classical and non-classical features, and are involved in antigen presentation and cytokine production.

Non-classic CD16+ monocyte.description: Non-classical monocytes are CD14lowCD16++ and patrol the vasculature, characterized by a unique transcriptional program involving CX3CR1 and anti-inflammatory functions.

Myeloid dendritic cell type 2.description: Myeloid dendritic cells type 2 (cDC2) are professional antigen-presenting cells that express CD1c and CLEC10A, and are specialized in presenting antigens to CD4+ T cells.
